Two comments

Flow, In The Year Of Wu Wei

This is a transcription of Brian Finnegan’s award winning single ‘Flow, In The Year Of Wu Wei’. It should really be thought of as three (or two and a bit) separate tunes, but as of writing I cannot find information about the titles of said tunes, and I thought I would leave it just in the meantime as it is, under one tune (as on the recording listing for the album https://thesession.org/recordings/7307) I decided to categorize it as a three-two, even though the time signature becomes 2/2 at one point.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-6TS7eiKZO8

↳ Posted by benóKoroit on March 22nd, 2021.
